title: Phone won't receive values if watch is collector (sideloaded)
symptom: After resetting the watch and sideloading the xDrip wear app, the phone does not receive BG values when the watch is set as collector, although the watch shows correct values. Communication appears unidirectional from phone to watch.
fix: Restart Wear Database from the three-point menu in the main window, or use an older version of xDrip (2021.03.08) and reset the watch to factory defaults.
evidence_quote: Today I installed latest nightly, pressed Restart Wear Database (in the 3 points menu in the main window) and got it fixed after running again the watch as collector.
